rows.title_short: Swimmers' Protection And Safety Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to ensure the safety of swimming pools and beachfronts in hotels and resorts by mandating the presence of at least one (1) certified lifeguard for every two hundred fifty (250) square meters of swimming pool or beachfront area during all hours of operation.

Mandates the LGUs to conduct regular inspection of the swimming pools and beachfront facilities of the hotels and resorts to ensure the strict compliance of the law.

Prescribes penalties for violation of the provisions of this Act.

rows.abstract: Seeks to extend the effectivity of R.A. 11494 otherwise known as the “Bayanihan to Recover as One Act” until June 30, 2021 to allow the government to continue its programs and efforts to combat the effects of Covid-19. Extends the following until June 30, 2021:1.) The validity for advices of allotments issued by the DBM for funds releases charged against Section 11 of the Bayanihan to Recover as One Act; 2.) The fund releases to the local government units and government institutions, and the utilization for programs, projects and activities enumerated in Section 10 0f the Bayanihan nto Recover ad One Act; 3.) Release of allotment releases from the standby fund as provided in Section 11 of the Bayanihan to Recover as One Act; and 4.) Release, obligations and disbursement of all unreleased appropriations authorized under the Bayanihan to Recover as One Act.
rows.status: Measure recommitted on 2020-12-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A FRAMEWORK TO PROTECT AND PROMOTE THE RIGHT TO ADEQUATE FOOD
rows.title_short: Right To Adequate Food Act
rows.abstract:
Provides a framework to address and eliminate hunger in an organized manner and protect the right of the people to adequate food.

Creates the Commission on the Right to Adequate Food which shall be the primary policy-making and coordinating body to guarantee full exercise of the right to adequate food.

Provides an integrated monitoring system that shall ensure that all government agencies at all levels shall collect data related to food and nutrition security, disaggregate collected data, monitor progress, and establish or identify an early warning mechanisms for food supply shortages and emergencies.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INCOME TAX RELIEF TO MEDICAL FRONTLINERS FOR TAXABLE YEAR TWO THOUSAND TWENTY
rows.title_short: Handog Sa Mga Bayaning Lumaban Kontra Covid-19 Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to exempt all medical frontliners from paying twenty-five percent (25%) of income tax due for taxable year 2020 subject to rules and regulations to be formulated by the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR).

Provides exemption of the salary or compensation, as well as the gross receipts from the exercise of profession or employment received by frontliners for taxable year 2020. 

States that income received by the medical frontliners from their other businesses, investments and other kinds of passive income not related to serving, treating, caring, aiding, assisting Covid-19 patients shall not be included in the tax exemption.

Authorizes the Secretary of Department of Finance to extend the payment of income tax to qualified frontliners for a period of not more than six (6) months.

LOWERING THE MINIMUM HEIGHT REQUIREMENT AND REMOVING THE HEIGHT WAIVER FOR APPLICANTS TO THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE (PNP), BUREAU OF FIRE PROTECTION (BFP), BUREAU OF JAIL MANAGEMENT AND PENOLOGY (BJMP), AND BUREAU OF CORRECTIONS (BUCOR), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, AS AMENDED, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8551, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9263, AS AMENDED, AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10575
rows.title_short: \" P N P, B F P, B J  M P And Bu Cor Height Equality Act\"
rows.abstract:
Seeks to lower the minimum height requirement for the appointment as officer or member of the PNP, uniformed personnel of the BFP and the BJMP and the BuCor as follows :

	a. from one meter and sixty-two centimeters (1.62 m.) to one meter and fifty-seven centimeters (1.57 m.) for male; and from one meter and fifty-seven centimeters (1.57 m.) to one meter fifty-two centimeters (1.52 m.) for female.

	b. applicants belonging to the Cultural Communities or Indigenous Peoples  must be at least one meter and fifty-two centimeters (1.52 m.) for male, and one meter and forty-seven centimeters (1.47 m.) for female.
	
States that cadets of the PNPA shall be retained at one meter and sixty-two centimeters (1.62 m.) for male, and one meter and fifty-seven centimeters (1.57 m.) for female.

rows.title_short: Increasing The Penalties For Perjury, Amending For The Purpose Articles 183 And 184 Of Act No. 3815, As Amended, Otherwise Known As " The Revised Penal Code"
rows.abstract:
Seeks to increase the penalty for providing false testimony under oath or through affidavit, or through solemn affirmation made in lieu of an oath from arresto mayor in its maximum period to prision correctional in its minimum period  to prision mayor in its minimum period to prision mayor in its medium period.

Provides that if the offender is a public officer or employee, the penalty of perpetual absolute disqualification from any appointive or elective position in the government or in any agency, entity or instrumentality and a fine not to exceed One million pesos (P1,000,000.00) shall be imposed on the perjuring public officer or employee.
